quote: A prototypical example of outcome disparity is gender disparity in image captions. ... introduce a bias evaluation for machine translation, showing that most systems overamplify gender bias.

In overamplification... example, found that in the imSitu image captioning data set, 58% of captions involving a person in a kitchen mention women. However, standard models trained on such data end up predicting people depicted in kitchens as women 63% of the time. ... They show that this overamplification consistently makes translations sound older and more male than the original authors.
A prototypical example of outcome disparity is gender disparity in image captions.
